description.text: Why study in CUFE 1.Located on a main campus in the heart of Beijing. 2.One of the leading comprehensive universities in China. 3.Provide a modern, convenient and safe international students’ apartment 4.High quality faculty---350 are professors and associate professors among a total of 670 full-time faculty members. 5.One of the national "211" key universities. 6.The first university of finance and economics in the Republic created by the China's central government. Program Introduction The program is designed to equip students with advanced skills in economic theory and econometrics. The emphasis is on development of students’ analytical skills, in particular their ability to identify key questions and to use theoretical and empirical tools to answer them. Teaching Objective To prepare students to be talents with global competencies, intellectual and practical skills, personal development and social responsibility, integrative learning, openness, development and inequality. Main Courses Principles of Management,macro-economics,Management Information System,Statistics, Marketing,Economic Law, Human Resource Management,Enterprise Strategic Management, Finance Management Fee Structure Tuition fee: 26000RMB/year Insurance: RMB 600/ per year, RMB 400/per half year Internship The university has special apartment to help international student find internship chances in good companies and organizations. Duration 2 years Degree Awarded Master of Economics Future Career Banking, consultancy, accountancy, marketing, advertising, human resource management and general management.

duration.text: The Economics at Central University of Finance and Economics is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Two Recommendation letters From Professors, associate professors or equivalents.

requirements.text: Bachelor’s degree, Higher proficiency in Chinese, Good health
